items.title: The Cybercab is Tesla’s ‘fork in the road’ moment
items.summary: The company is about to formally launch the gold two-seater, with no steering wheel or pedals -- a move that could change Tesla forever.

items.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
items.summary: The high-profile startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million.

items.title: Utilities are racing to link up with fusion startups, with Realta Fusion the latest to benefit
items.summary: The grid has been straining under the weight of new AI data centers, and that has utilities courting fusion startups.

items.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
items.summary: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.

items.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
items.summary: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

items.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
items.summary: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."

items.title: Qualcomm backs Ultrahuman in $70M round on bet to turn smart rings into computers
items.summary: Ultrahuman is targeting a $200 million annual revenue run rate by January 2027 as it builds a new Qualcomm-powered smart ring.

items.title: Circular unveils Ring 3 series with contactless payments and on-finger vibration alerts
items.summary: The Circular Ring 3 series announcement comes amid a year of heightened competition in the smart ring market, following the launches of the Oura Ring 5 and RingConn Gen 3.

items.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
items.summary: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.

items.title: Google launches AI voice features in Gmail, Docs, and Keep
items.summary: Users can search for emails or draft documents using the new conversational feature.

items.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
items.summary: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.

items.title: TikTok comments are getting more interactive with voice comments, polls, and more
items.summary: With the additions, the app is borrowing features from messaging apps as it looks to deepen engagement on its platform.

items.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
items.summary: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.

items.title: Amazon’s Zoox expands its robotaxi service to Las Vegas airport
items.summary: Zoox is expanding to this critical ride-hailing destination a few weeks after it started charging for robotaxi rides.

items.title: The Builders Stage brings practical strategies for scaling startups to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: The Builders Stage is returning to TechCrunch Disrupt, bringing together founders, startup operators, and investors for practical conversations on what it takes to build and scale.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
items.summary: The acquisition also leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.

items.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Real World AI Stage features Nvidia, robots, and extinct animals
items.summary: On our new Real World AI stage, we’ll be focusing on the intersection between the digital and physical, and all the ways we’ll continue to see a blending of the two.

items.title: Google spared from ad-business breakup, but judge orders changes to how it operates
items.summary: Google has dodged an effort to break up its ad business, but a judge said Wednesday that the company will need to adjust its business to benefit competitors.

items.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
items.summary: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.
